personalInfo.name: Anudeep Sri Bathina
personalInfo.title: AI Architect
personalInfo.summary: AI Architect with 11+ years of experience building production AI across Fortune 500 environments. Leads agentic AI, multimodal RAG, governed data platforms, and engineering teams from architecture through operations.

experience.description: Owns architecture and delivery for AT&T's $4M competitive-intelligence platform, leading a 16-person team across agentic AI, multimodal RAG, governed data, and production operations.
Launched AT&T's first public-facing GenAI product for 1,500+ API developers, cutting integration time 80% with 99% query resolution, sub-2-second latency, and 99% uptime.
Led an 11-person team delivering an Azure Databricks and Spark ranking platform for Unilever UK, improving Precision@10 from 62% to 85% and reducing stockouts 18%.
Independently built Strait, a proprietary Big Data and ML platform using PySpark, Dask, predictive models, and containers.
Delivered Azure data migrations and analytics systems across airline and healthcare workloads, improving SLA compliance and query performance.

education.description: Graduate research in computer vision (YOLOv8 and ResNet-50). Focus on advanced algorithms and applied AI.
Undergraduate engineering degree in electrical and electronics engineering.

publications.title: Transfer Learning for Groundfish Recognition (Thesis)
publications.description: Developed a cross-database recognition system using YOLOv8 and ResNet-50, reporting 94.10% mAP on the thesis evaluation workload and examining data scarcity in underwater environments.

publications.title: Blueprint of IoT for Smart Cities
publications.description: Co-authored a handbook chapter on IoT blueprinting and management/system challenges for smart city development in emerging markets.
